q1.method: fixed HGBR point predictions with pooled normalized split-conformal versus 18 region-by-task-type groupwise calibrations
negative_findings: Groupwise calibration did not improve worst-group absolute coverage deviation by the required 0.02.

Twenty-four calibration observations per group make the finite-sample groupwise quantile coarse; empirical coverage is descriptive, not conditional-coverage proof.
